001package com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.intel.events.sd;
002
003import java.awt.Color;
004
005import com.fs.starfarer.api.Global;
006import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.econ.CommodityOnMarketAPI;
007import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.econ.MarketAPI;
008import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.Commodities;
009import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.Conditions;
010import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.intel.events.BaseEventFactor;
011import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.intel.events.BaseEventIntel;
012import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.intel.events.BaseFactorTooltip;
013import com.fs.starfarer.api.ui.TooltipMakerAPI;
014import com.fs.starfarer.api.ui.TooltipMakerAPI.TooltipCreator;
015import com.fs.starfarer.api.util.Misc;
016
017public class SDDFuelFactor extends BaseEventFactor {
018        
019        protected MarketAPI market;
020
021        public SDDFuelFactor() {
022                this.market = Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarket("sindria");
023        }
024
025        @Override
026        public boolean shouldShow(BaseEventIntel intel) {
027                return market.isInEconomy() && !market.hasCondition(Conditions.DECIVILIZED); // && getProgress(intel) > 0;
028        }
029        
030        @Override
031        public TooltipCreator getMainRowTooltip(final BaseEventIntel intel) {
032                return new BaseFactorTooltip() {
033                        @Override
034                        public void createTooltip(TooltipMakerAPI tooltip, boolean expanded, Object tooltipParam) {
035                                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
036                                tooltip.addPara("Reduced fuel production " + market.getOnOrAt() + " %s: %s points "
037                                                + "of event progress per point of fuel production below %s.", 0f,
038                                                h, market.getName(), "" + SDDPoints.PROGRESS_PER_MISSING_FUEL_POINT,
039                                                "" + SDDPoints.FUEL_PRODUCTION_THRESHOLD);
040                        }
041                        
042                };
043        }
044
045        @Override
046        public String getProgressStr(BaseEventIntel intel) {
047//              if (getProgress(intel) <= 0) return "";
048                return super.getProgressStr(intel);
049        }
050        
051        @Override
052        public int getProgress(BaseEventIntel intel) {
053                CommodityOnMarketAPI com = market.getCommodityData(Commodities.FUEL);
054                if (com == null) return 0;
055                int fuel = (int) Math.round(com.getMaxSupply());
056                int missing = SDDPoints.FUEL_PRODUCTION_THRESHOLD - fuel;
057                int points = missing * SDDPoints.PROGRESS_PER_MISSING_FUEL_POINT;
058                return Math.max(0, points);
059        }
060
061        @Override
062        public String getDesc(BaseEventIntel intel) {
063                return "Reduced fuel production " + market.getOnOrAt() + " " + market.getName();
064        }
065        
066        @Override
067        public Color getDescColor(BaseEventIntel intel) {
068                if (getProgress(intel) > 0) return Misc.getTextColor();
069                return Misc.getGrayColor();
070        }
071
072        
073}
